content: Ar bela dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummagan-megismalad dulemar-abargi sules daed. Sulegogua, dulemar-irwa Bab-Dummad-asabin gwisguega, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ukleged ukega, degine, dulemar-isgued-ular Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ukega nugsalesdaed.
Adi, mer mesagwar dulemar-ibmar-wissurmalad-imakega, degi, dulemar-igar-nuedgi-bangudmalad-imakegar. Ar ade, na e-sunna nolloo gumogad, sunna isgumogad.
A-ulale, na e-isgued-ular, degi, dulemar-isgued-ular, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged ukmogargebed.
Dule na-dukin geg wargwengi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga na nugsaed. Unnila Bab-Dummad ese golergebed, igi-Bab-Dummad Aarónʼse gocha-gusmoga, deyobi, ese gormogargebed.
Ar Cristoʼmoga na-dukin dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga nug-imaksasurmogad. Bab-Dummadi Jesús-nug-imaksad. Bab-Dummad ega sogsagusad:

content.text: Igi Melquisedec maigusa, deyob be gumogad.”

content: Cristo we-napneggi-gudigusgu, Bab-Dummad-nabir-burgwedgi-e-ollor-imakedse ibyanis-abalagi ise-wilegar binnasuli-gordii gusad. Bab-Dummad we-Cristo-ese-binnasur-gochad itosad. Ar Bab-Dummad, Cristo eba-nue-uaya-nika-nanadigusadba itosad.
Ar Cristo Bab-Dummad-Machi-inigwele, na nue-wilesadbali, Bab-Dummadba-ibsaed durdaksad.
Agi nue-durdaksasoggu, bela dulemar-eba-ibsaedga abonoleged-degisadeguad-ibedga gunonisunnad.
Geb Bab-Dummad sognonisunnad, Melquisedecʼyob be dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga an be-nug imaksunye.
We-igargangine, bukidar anmar egi sunmaked-nika-inigwele, nuegwadsun bela bega sogegala, dutusulid, ar ade, bemar amba nue-aku itomalad.

Ar bemar bato dikasurgus odurdaked-sailaga gusawilubmalanad. Emigindi, amba bemarga gannar Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-onodedgi ibgwensuli-durdaklemaladgi bega sunmaked be abemalad. Ar bemar deyob gunonisoggu, amba bemar nunis gobergebed, ar geg be amba san gunmalad.
Ar dule amba nunis-gobnaile, amba Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-napiragwad nue-wissulid. Ar ade, amba Bab-Dummadgi mimmiga gued.
Ar san-gunmaladdi bato wedi dule-nue-Bab-Dummad-igargi-nasgumaimaladgadid. Ar dule-magasar-ibmar-itogedgadid, igid igar-nuedi, igid igar-isganabali.
